# Project Guidelines

## Component Usage

- Use the reusable components in `src/components` for every page and feature.
- Before creating new UI, check `src/components` and reuse an existing component when one fits.
- If a shared UI pattern does not exist, create it as a reusable component under `src/components` before using it in a page.
- Keep page components focused on composition and page-specific behavior; do not duplicate shared UI markup or styling.
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes for component and page styling.
